sheets.title:
Ignorance, Naivete and Fear  

 vs. 

 Justice, Truth and Peace 

 A Jewish Response to a Pandemic
sheets.summary:
Sources on how our traditions addressed moments of challenge and fear in the past, helping people find the courage, resolve and faith to move forward.  The focus is on texts that relate to justice, truth and peace as frameworks for us to:

1.Be knowledgeable about what is happening so that we can gain a sense of resolve about what is just in what we do, 
2. Balance honesty about the reality with a sense of calm as we seek to manage transcend our fears, and
3. Understand that how peace may not be tranquility, but the wholeness that will help us rise to the best within us as individuals, as a Jewish community and as human beings.

This sheet concludes with practical advice, as well, for how to remain informed, vigilant, honest and calm in this moment of great upheaval.
